query_text: Confidential Information includes all information disclosed by the disclosing party, whether or not marked confidential, including information already known or later made public.
The receiving party must protect confidential information for seven years after disclosure.
The receiving party may freely use ideas and know-how retained in memory after reviewing the confidential information.
Confidential information excludes information already known, public, independently developed, or lawfully received from a third party.
Any breach requires the receiving party to pay one million dollars in liquidated damages plus all consequential damages.
Employee assigns every invention created during employment, including personal projects made on personal time with personal equipment.
The company may reduce salary retroactively for business reasons or performance concerns.
Employee may be eligible for a bonus as determined by management in its sole discretion.
For two years after leaving, employee may not work for any competing or similar business anywhere in the world.
The company will reimburse reasonable pre-approved business expenses after employee submits receipts under company policy.
Customer may withhold payment for any reason and vendor must continue providing services during the dispute.
Deliverables are accepted if they meet objective acceptance criteria or customer does not reject them with specific reasons within ten business days.
Vendor is liable for all direct, indirect, consequential, special, and punitive damages without limitation.
Vendor will use reasonable efforts to keep customer data secure.
Customer owns all vendor technology, methods, know-how, and tools used to provide the services.
